items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bobby Darin. >> [INTERVIEWER] Darin, greatest one I ever heard. He beats Louie with feeling on 'Mack the Knife,' I thought. Bobby Darrin is the only one that had that feeling on 'Mack the Knife.'

ctx.x: Darin, greatest one I ever heard. He beats Louie with feeling on 'Mack the Knife,' I thought. Bobby Darrin is the only one that had that feeling on 'Mack the Knife.'
